extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors / contributors attempting to create or recover an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors trying to create or locate a specific Wikipedia article title, including account requirements, searching for existing content, and handling deletions or redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedians' comedians" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the search to confirm the topic isn't already covered under a different name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspecting 'What links here' can reveal existing coverage or related pages that reference the topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check sister projects for the topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for Comedians' comedians on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiquote, Wikisource, Wikiversity, Commons, Wikivoyage, Wikinews, Wikidata, Wikispecies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant content may exist on a sister project even if no main-namespace article is present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for recent-creation visibility delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to resolve caching/propagation delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and add redirects when appropriate so users find the intended page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons to determine whether to contest, restore, or improve and recreate the article.
